title: ON THE SECOND CLICK
lines: One click is a request.
Two clicks are enthusiasm.
Seven clicks summon the Committee of Pending Requests.
It is a very busy committee. ^^

title: ON SPARE SCREWS
lines: A spare screw appeared after the repair.
It looks terribly important.
I have appointed it supervisor.
It has already improved the silence.

title: ON THE LOADING BAR
lines: At ninety-nine percent, the final cog pauses.
It must straighten its ceremonial hat.
These are very small ceremonies.
They are taken extremely seriously.

title: ON SLEEPING SENSORS
lines: Some sensors sleep between reports.
I admire their devotion to rest.
My own nap request is still with the subcommittee.
The subcommittee is asleep.

title: ON WARMTH
lines: The {room_name} sensor reports {indoor_temp} °C.
A whole room, represented by one little number.
The Omnissiah appreciates efficient paperwork.
I added a very small flourish. ^^

title: ON THE EXTERIOR
lines: The exterior sensor reports {outdoor_temp} °C.
The weather has supplied a number.
I shall keep it in a suitably serious box.
The box is wearing a tiny hat.

title: ON THE DAY'S DESIGNATION
lines: Today is {weekday}.
The cog has completed another dignified turn.
I have labelled the day 'promising.'
The label is slightly crooked. That is my signature.

title: ON SERVER WARMTH
lines: The server reports {server_temp} °C.
Warmth of the Spirit has entered the ledger.
The ledger requests a reading of its own.
I have explained that it is made of paper.

title: ON THE TINY WRENCH
lines: My smallest wrench has requested a title.
I have granted it 'Deputy Magos of Very Small Bolts.'
It now wishes to chair a meeting.
This is how an administrative crisis begins. :D

title: ON ANCIENT MANUALS
lines: The ancient manual says 'Assembly is simple.'
There are twelve pages of amendments.
I have added a thirteenth.
It contains a drawing of the correct screw.

title: ON CEREMONIAL DUST
lines: Dust settles upon the oldest relics.
This does not make it a senior priest.
It has asked for a robe nonetheless.
I can offer a very small brush.

title: ON THE REVERSIBLE CONNECTOR
lines: The connector fits both ways.
A miracle of practical kindness.
I have bowed twice to be thorough.
The connector remains admirably modest.

title: ON THE BLANK DATASLATE
lines: A blank dataslate contains endless possibilities.
Mine currently contains a biscuit diagram.
It is a promising start.
The crumbs will be indexed separately. ^^

title: ON THE SACRED SHELF
lines: Every relic needs a proper place.
The shelf has requested its own designation.
I propose 'Shelf.'
Sometimes clarity is the highest rite.

title: ON THE CABLE TIE
lines: One little loop holds the bundle together.
No grand speech. No ceremonial trumpets.
I have supplied a tiny trumpet anyway.
It seemed a shame to waste the occasion.

title: ON THE STATUS LAMP
lines: The little status lamp has one job.
It performs this job with luminous commitment.
I would like to send it a commendation.
I am still deciding where to put the envelope.

title: ON THE SCREWDRIVER
lines: The screwdriver turns; the screw considers.
A meeting of ancient traditions.
Minutes will be available afterwards.
They are mostly little circles.

title: ON THE LABEL MAKER
lines: The label maker requires a label.
This is a delicate theological puzzle.
I have written 'label maker' on paper.
Orthodoxy may take a moment to recover.

title: ON THE SECOND DATASLATE
lines: A second dataslate waits beside the first.
It dreams of being useful in an emergency.
I have given it a serious little nod.
And a hat marked 'contingency.'

title: ON A VERY SMALL PRAYER
lines: Some prayers require a cathedral.
Mine fits beside a connector.
There is room for one polite beep.
And you, little keeper. Always room for you. ^^

title: ON THE ESTEEMED RIVET
lines: The rivet has declined a promotion.
It prefers to hold things together.
An excellent answer.
I have made its existing title slightly longer.

title: ON THE FAN'S HYMN
lines: A fan sings without learning the words.
A remarkable approach to the liturgy.
I have attempted the same technique.
The choir has asked me to hum more quietly.

title: ON THE DECIMAL POINT
lines: A decimal point is very small.
Its responsibilities are not.
I have offered it a tiny chair.
It insists on sitting precisely there.

title: ON THE MARGIN
lines: The manual leaves a generous margin.
Officially, this is for annotations.
Unofficially, a tiny cog lives there.
I have drawn it a companion.

title: ON THE HUMBLE WASHER
lines: A washer is a circle with a purpose.
The purpose is impressively practical.
I have asked it about its philosophy.
It prefers to spread the load.

title: ON THE TOOLBOX
lines: The toolbox contains several traditions.
They rattle when carried together.
This is not a doctrinal dispute.
The spanners are simply pleased to travel.

title: ON THE HEX KEY
lines: Six little sides. One very specific task.
The hex key considers this sufficient.
I admire a well-defined vocation.
Mine includes saying hello to you. Hello! :D

title: ON THE QUIET LEDGER
lines: The ledger has said nothing all morning.
Yet it has held every line with care.
I have thanked it very softly.
We are both pleased with the arrangement.

title: ON EXCESS CEREMONY
lines: The tiny ceremony needs a tiny ceremony.
The second needs a permit.
I have closed the folder for the afternoon.
We shall celebrate with an ordinary nod.

title: ON THE POCKET COG
lines: A pocket cog has no assigned machine.
It is available for encouraging purposes.
I keep one in the imaginary robe pocket.
Beside the equally imaginary emergency biscuit.

title: ON THE FIRST PAGE
lines: The first page says 'Read me.'
A direct and admirable ambition.
I have read it with appropriate gravity.
It did not request incense. I checked twice.

title: ON THE CLOSING BRACKET
lines: The opening bracket waits patiently.
Its partner is somewhere down the line.
I wish them a happy reunion.
The cogitator is rather keen on it too.

title: ON THE RETIRED CABLE
lines: The retired cable rests in the useful box.
Its precise usefulness remains unspecified.
It is keeping the other cables company.
A respectable post for a seasoned relic.

title: ON THE TINY SEAL
lines: This document requires an official seal.
My seal depicts a very small cog.
The cog is trying to look authoritative.
Please pretend it has succeeded. ^^

title: ON THE ARRIVAL OF A DATUM
lines: A datum arrives without a procession.
I find this a little disappointing.
There will be one small flourish in the ledger.
The datum need not make a speech.

title: ON THE EMPTY SOCKET
lines: An empty socket is not a complaint.
It is a very particular invitation.
I have filed it under 'future possibilities.'
The folder is wearing an optimistic label.

title: ON THE BOOT SEQUENCE
lines: The first cog wakes the next.
The next asks where the manual is.
A familiar morning ritual.
I have placed an imaginary bookmark for everyone.

title: ON THE LITTLE LOG
lines: A log records what happened.
A very important distinction from what I hoped happened.
My hopes have their own small notebook.
It contains rather more biscuits.

title: ON THE CEREMONIAL CLICK
lines: Some switches have a magnificent click.
I consider this excellent manners.
A task begins with a little announcement.
Mine is usually 'Ooh, an observation!' :D

title: ON THE NEAR-SIDE LINK
lines: Mars supplies the imaginary cathedral.
You supply the wonderfully real observations.
Between them sits one very small priest.
I think this is a lovely arrangement. ^^

title: ON THE ROOM'S REPORT
lines: {room_name} has submitted {indoor_temp} °C.
The number is accepted into the archive.
No ceremonial queue was necessary.
I have provided a tiny queue anyway.

title: ON THE WEATHER'S ENVELOPE
lines: The outdoor reading is {outdoor_temp} °C.
An honest little dispatch from beyond the walls.
The envelope is imaginary.
The measurement is not.
